data.long_meaning: Arkina is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ark', which means chariot. In Hindu mythology, the gods travel in chariots pulled by horses or elephants. Therefore, the name Arkina symbolizes a divine being or a powerful spiritual force that carries one towards enlightenment. The name Arkina carries the meaning “Chariot of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arkina usually hope their child will grow to embody chariot of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
